in_marathi.name: Premchandra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Premchandra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Premchandra is made up of two Sanskrit words: 'Prem' which means love and 'Chandra' which means moon. So, Premchandra translates to 'Precious Moon'. It is a name that evokes feelings of love, devotion, and the divine.
